titles.native: 劇場版マクロスΔ　激情のワルキューレ

description:
A compilation film of the Macross Delta anime series that features new scenes to tell a different story.

In 2067, Freyja Wion leaves her hometown, achieves her dream of joining Walküre, and starts to sing.

(Source: Hulu)
